scope: LAPIC selected retired-clock binding, periodic phase and incoming checkpoint epoch; preserve wall mode and legacy wire.

assumption_register.assumption: The LAPIC owns the VM clock selected at construction, independent of later thread-local clock bindings.
assumption_register.basis: TimingContext::current is thread-local and the clock mode is immutable; VMM constructs controllers inside its selected context.
assumption_register.dependent_result: Retain an Arc to a retired clock, not an ambient lookup for each MMIO operation.
assumption_register.stress_test: Reprogram the controller under an unrelated ambient clock and advance both clocks independently.
assumption_register.falsification_probe: CCR or expiry follows the unrelated ambient clock.
assumption_register.qualification: Instance identity and reprogramming tested under unrelated ambient scope.

assumption_register.assumption: The incoming relative timer age must be anchored to the incoming clock epoch before VM clock publication.
assumption_register.basis: Vmm::restore_snapshot_bundle prepares controllers before committing TimingContext state.
assumption_register.dependent_result: prepare_for_clock receives incoming elapsed_nanos and controller replacement retains the target binding.
assumption_register.stress_test: Source and target have different epochs; publish controller first and clock second, then advance source and target separately.
assumption_register.falsification_probe: Restored CCR changes with source advancement or jumps when the incoming clock is committed.
assumption_register.qualification: Actual VMM wall-mode file continuation and source-level retired controller publication order tested separately; retired VMM construction remains rejected.

assumption_register.assumption: A logical timer observation interval is less than one complete u64 nanosecond-clock cycle.
assumption_register.basis: TimingContext declares wrapping u64 nanoseconds; finite scheduler service intervals and modeled u32 timer counts/divisors are much shorter than 2^64 ns.
assumption_register.dependent_result: Use wrapping subtraction for the selected logical epoch while retaining checkpoint age in u128.
assumption_register.stress_test: Start immediately before u64 wrap, capture afterward, restore at a different target epoch.
assumption_register.falsification_probe: CCR or saved relative age disagrees across a single wrap; intervals covering an entire clock cycle are outside this representation.
assumption_register.qualification: Single wrapping epoch and fractional-phase continuation tested. Full-cycle observation gaps remain excluded.

units.clock_representation: wrapping u64 nanoseconds plus exact phase 0/1/2 thirds of a nanosecond
units.complexity: O(1) arithmetic/phase space per controller; lock contention not bounded by this claim

acceptance: Two unchanged public-MMIO regressions fail against the actual old RAX library and pass against integrated production code.
All eight divisors retain periodic phase and coalesced pending-latch behavior.
Source clock identity is absent from checkpoint images; target clock identity survives replacement.
The exact 181-byte pre-change producer fixture decodes and re-encodes byte-identically.
Complete owning root and C API binaries, workspace fmt/check/build/clippy and fresh C/C++ consumers pass at stated feature profiles.
Commit exact owned paths through git add then red -m --staged --run; remove idle canonical build/scratch roots afterward.
Both actual VMM base and complete capture paths detach a device clock selected independently of the admitted wall-mode VM. No retired VMM construction claim.

affected: Complete relative-age checkpoint preparation and publication
Legacy and complete VMM device-image capture detach runtime clock references.
unchanged: Native ARM/x86 CPU adapter state codecs and SDK calls
Default VMM clock mode and scheduling-policy admission

validation.native_file_continuation: One owning test exercises actual Apple-Silicon one/two/four-CPU files through the changed caller.
validation.realmode_boot: Host-gated to x86_64; all-target compilation only on this AArch64 host. No runtime boot claim.

fixture_correction.scope: Full suite ran on the combined ten-path LAPIC source and the separate test-only TCP correction. Both are byte-identical after that fixture-only parent commit.

red_green.standalone_scope: 112 existing tests +11 new clock cases +2 unchanged public-MMIO reproductions; not an independently compiled VMM.

legacy_wire.scope: Actual pre-change library producer; exact serialization equality and strict decode/re-encode.

bounded_scope.finding: Accepted deterministic VMM default, native exact retirement, RTC/external events and replay remain incomplete.
Public-SDK streaming FPSR loss and physical Intel runtime qualification remain unresolved.

quality_gates.coverage: Selected device requirements covered; original goal remains open.
quality_gates.units: Hz/ns and integer phase calculations explicit.
quality_gates.edge_cases: Divisors, wrap, phase, coalescing, unrelated clock and old wire checked.
quality_gates.provenance: Actual old producer and current source/artifact hashes retained.
quality_gates.bounded_expansion: No default-policy, native CPU debug/profile or RTC changes.
quality_gates.integrity: Exact owned paths; protected checkouts preserved.
